The '''Estuan Theater''' was a [[theater]] located aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It was named for renowned [[Dactrurian]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Anorad Estuan]], and could support both live and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] performances. It seated nine hundred beings, and each seat was equipped with [[D-baffling]] to eliminate ambient noise.
